searchText: What do people think of running toward a 29 April devnet 0 launch? <parithoshj> > <parithoshj> We'd ideally want all clients ready, but to start off are there any clients that are confident they'd be ready with all eips by then? (re @amphora_interop_bot: <matt> What do people think of running toward a 29 April devnet 0 launch?) Would that include EIP7251? It has not been merged into the official Electra spec https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3668 assuming we can get it merged by mid next week, would clients be down to target that? or not enough time? Will check with the team first thing on Monday 🫡
